cuts.item: Central Mass Mosquito Control program membership (assessment), possible Town Meeting question on whether to remain in the program

statements.statement: The town manager said the town faces a budgetary shortfall of substance and that the mosquito control assessment is $100,000, which she wants Town Meeting voters to decide whether to continue.
A member said the town's share of the Central Mass Mosquito Control assessment is around 91,000, a little bit more.

warning: EXTRACTED BY A LANGUAGE MODEL FROM MACHINE CAPTIONS. Every figure is as heard and may be misheard; every line carries the second in the video, which is the record.
